2607.21130.title: Hardware-Software Co-Design for Float16 On-Device Training on RISC-V Single-Core
2607.21130.paper_summary: By leveraging standard RISC-V extensions, namely Zfh (scalar float16) and Zvfh (vector float16), this work proposes an open-source framework to enable complete on-device training on resource-constrained RISC-V single-core. Our approach allows memory footprint reduction by about 50% as compared to using float32 and with minimal model performance degradation. We also facilitate transfer learning and fine-tuning scenarios by incorporating layer-freezing capabilities. Our work builds onto AIfES, an open-source, modular and generic DNN training and inference framework for embedded systems that can be extended with custom hardware-specific functions. The benefits of float16 is further emphasized by outlining the low area overhead of Zfh on a RV64GC super-scalar out-of-order FPGA softcore (+1.15% LUT6 and +0.05% FF at 175MHz). Finally, we discuss the architecture of a Zvfh implementation within the same RISC-V core.
2607.21130.paper_summary_zh: 藉由利用標準的 RISC-V 擴展，即 Zfh（標量 float16）和 Zvfh（向量 float16），本研究提出了一個開源框架，以實現資源受限的 RISC-V 單核心上的完整裝置內訓練。我們的方法相比使用 float32，能將記憶體佔用減少約 50%，且對模型性能的影響最小。我們還通過納入層凍結功能來促進遷移學習和微調場景。我們的工作建立在 AIfES 之上，這是一個開源的、模組化的、通用的 DNN 訓練和推理框架，適用於嵌入式系統，並可以擴展自定義硬體特定功能。通過概述 Zfh 在 RV64GC 超標量亂序 FPGA 軟核上的低面積開銷（+1.15% LUT6 和 +0.05% FF 在 175MHz），進一步強調了 float16 的好處。最後，我們討論了在同一 RISC-V 核心內 Zvfh 實現的架構。
